description: What a Dream of the Earth player carries. One record (rkey 'self'), overwritten as it changes, so it follows them to any device. Honour system: nothing referees it.

items.description: How many of each kind. Unknown kinds and out-of-range counts are ignored.

moonseed.description: Falls at each new moon; eaten to change your stats.

prism.description: Worn, the ley lines show and can be ridden. Every creature starts with one.

tidefin.description: Worn, a land-born creature's swim wakes.

mossfoot.description: Worn, a sea-born creature's run wakes.

worn.description: What you wear, by kind, in the order put on: at most two, each something you carry.

took.description: The finds you've had this moon (each spot gives each player its thing once a moon).

got.description: The pigeons whose gifts you've had (newest last), so each comes once.

kit.description: The starting kit you've been given (1: the prism), so an older pouch is given what it lacks, once.

lunation.description: The new moon (counted from 6 January 2000) whose moonseed you were last given, so each moon gives one.
